text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
```
